title: Generic boss
text: Each preset against a level 63 boss with no creature type. No racial depends on the weapon. A race gets its own rotation or gear where that clearly beats the preset's in the sim, and its row says what changed.

title: Beast target
text: On a Beast boss, Troll Beast Slaying and Dwarf Big Game Hunter add 5% damage.

title: Elemental target
text: On an Elemental boss, High Order and Windshaper Elemental Insight add 5% damage.

title: Humanoid target
text: Priests only. Dwarf Priests can cast Chastise, which works only on Humanoids.

title: Racials off
text: Every race on its base stats, with all racials left out.

title: The Human Spirit
text: Spirit increased by 10%.
short: Spirit increased by 10%.

title: Ruthless
text: +1% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks, with any weapon.
short: +1% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks, with any weapon.

title: Artisan's Precision
text: +1% hit chance with spells and attacks.
short: +1% hit chance with spells and attacks.

title: Command
text: Damage dealt by Hunter and Warlock pets increased by 5%.
short: Damage dealt by Hunter and Warlock pets increased by 5%.

title: Elune's Light
text: +10% critical strike chance for 15s, 3 min cooldown.
short: +10% critical strike chance for 15s, 3 min cooldown.

title: Shadowmeld
text: Slip into the shadows, 2 min cooldown in combat. The next stealth ability (Ravage, Ambush, Garrote) can follow it.
short: Slip into the shadows, 2 min cooldown in combat. The next stealth ability (Ravage, Ambush, Garrote) can follow it.

title: Read Leyline
text: A 2s cast that raises health and mana regeneration by 50% for 15s away from a Ley Line, 2 min cooldown.
short: A 2s cast that raises health and mana regeneration by 50% for 15s away from a Ley Line, 2 min cooldown.

title: Expansive Mind
text: Maximum Mana, Rage or Energy increased by 5%.
short: Maximum Mana, Rage or Energy increased by 5%.

title: Eureka!
text: For 8s, direct damage abilities cost 10% less and deal 10% more damage (DoTs too for Warlocks, heals too for Priests), 2 min cooldown.
short: For 8s, direct damage abilities cost 10% less and deal 10% more damage (DoTs too for Warlocks, heals too for Priests), 2 min cooldown.

title: Blood Fury
text: Attack power and spell power increased by 10% for 15s, 2 min cooldown.
short: Attack power and spell power increased by 10% for 15s, 2 min cooldown.

title: Touch of the Grave
text: Spells and attacks have a 20% chance (30% for Mages, Priests and Warlocks) to deal Shadow damage equal to 5% of your maximum health and heal you for it. At most once every 15s, and it cannot crit.
short: 20% chance a hit (30% for Mages, Priests and Warlocks) to deal Shadow damage equal to 5% of max health. At most once every 15s.

title: Endurance
text: Health increased by 5%.
short: Health increased by 5%.

title: Berserking
text: Attack and casting speed increased by 10% for 15s, 3 min cooldown.
short: Attack and casting speed increased by 10% for 15s, 3 min cooldown.

title: Wind Blessed
text: Spellcasting, melee and ranged haste increased by 2%.
short: Spellcasting, melee and ranged haste increased by 2%.

title: Big Game Hunter
text: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.
short: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

title: Beast Slaying
text: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.
short: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

title: Elemental Insight
text: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.
short: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.

title: Chastise
text: Dwarf Priests: an instant Holy hit on a Humanoid, 2 min cooldown.
short: Dwarf Priests: an instant Holy hit on a Humanoid, 2 min cooldown.

title: Starshards
text: Night Elf Priests: Arcane damage over 6s, 30s cooldown.
short: Night Elf Priests: Arcane damage over 6s, 30s cooldown.

title: Dark Sacrifice
text: Undead Priests: trade health for mana over 15s, 10 min cooldown.
short: Undead Priests: trade health for mana over 15s, 10 min cooldown.

title: Base stats
text: The race's own stats, with no racials.
short: The race's own stats, with no racials.

title: Target type
text: Racials, talents and spells that work only on this creature type.
short: Racials, talents and spells that work only on this creature type.

title: Warrior
text: Orc is best on Fury and Fury 2H. Undead is best on Arms. The best Alliance race on Fury is Night Elf, 0.5% behind. Orc's Blood Fury adds the most on Fury, 17.6 DPS (1.8%). On a Beast boss, Troll is best on Fury, 0.3% ahead of Dwarf. On an Elemental boss, High Order and Windshaper are best on Fury, 4.1% ahead of Orc.

title: Rogue
text: Undead is best on every Rogue preset. Gnome is next, 0.4% behind on Combat Daggers. Undead's Touch of the Grave adds the most on Combat Daggers, 16.7 DPS (2.2%). On a Beast boss, Troll is best on Combat Daggers, 0.2% ahead of Dwarf. On an Elemental boss, High Order and Windshaper are best on Combat Daggers, 3.8% ahead of Undead.

title: Hunter
text: Orc is best on Beast Mastery, Marksmanship and Survival. Night Elf is best on Lone Wolf. Orc's Command adds the most on Beast Mastery, 15.9 DPS (1.4%). On a Beast boss, Troll is best on Beast Mastery, 0.2% ahead of Dwarf. On an Elemental boss, High Order and Windshaper are best on Beast Mastery, 2.1% ahead of Orc.

title: Paladin
text: Undead is best on every Paladin preset. Human is next, 0.7% behind on Ret sub-Holy. Undead's Touch of the Grave adds the most on Ret sub-Holy, 14.4 DPS (1.5%). On a Beast boss, Dwarf is best on Ret sub-Holy, 3.5% ahead of Undead.

title: Shaman
text: Orc is best on Enhancement, Enh Imp GW, Enh Water Shield and Enh Mana Tide. Windshaper is best on Elemental and Elemental Mana Tide. The best Alliance race on Enhancement is Dwarf, 0.7% behind. Orc's Blood Fury adds the most on Enhancement, 11.2 DPS (1.3%). On a Beast boss, Dwarf is best on Enhancement, level with Troll. On an Elemental boss, Windshaper is best on Enhancement, 4.6% ahead of Orc.

title: Druid
text: Night Elf is best on Feral and Balance. High Order is best on Balance Wrath. The best Horde race on Feral is Windshaper, 1.5% behind. Night Elf's Shadowmeld adds the most on Feral, 13.4 DPS (1.6%). On an Elemental boss, High Order and Windshaper are best on Feral, 3.3% ahead of Night Elf.

title: Mage
text: Gnome is best on Fire, Frostfire and Arcane. High Order is best on Frost. The best Horde race on Fire is Undead, 0.3% behind. Undead's Touch of the Grave adds the most on Fire, 11.8 DPS (1.1%). On a Beast boss, Troll is best on Fire, 3.6% ahead of Gnome. On an Elemental boss, High Order is best on Fire, 3.8% ahead of Gnome.

title: Warlock
text: Orc is best on Demonology, Affliction and Destruction. Undead is best on Destruction Fire. Undead's Touch of the Grave adds the most on Demonology, 12.0 DPS (1.1%). On a Beast boss, Troll is best on Demonology, 3.6% ahead of Orc.

title: Priest
text: Undead is best on every Priest preset. Troll is next, 0.3% behind on Shadow. The best Alliance race on Shadow is Human, 0.4% behind. Undead's Touch of the Grave adds the most on Shadow, 11.7 DPS (1.2%). On a Beast boss, Troll is best on Shadow, 0.4% ahead of Dwarf.
